id table row 241 (id 0x446, which cannot be opened: no layout has a unit of its key 0x587): key-list pointer to the list of id 0x498, one key, 0x5f2 (units of 30,824,400 bytes) [A7 IV 0x1faeb0c]
the same row: id 0x446 to 0x43f, the id the firmware asks for an output plane above 13,271,040 bytes [A7 IV 0x1faeb08]
size class 3, second entry: the output buffer's memory id, 0x2d9 (units of 13,271,040 bytes) to 0x43f; the sequence takes its output buffer id from here (0x4311f0) [A7 IV 0x143c7c0]
size class 3, second entry: output width and height [A7 IV 0x143c7bc]
